dialogues.speaker: Cadmael
dialogues.text: Somewhere else... Will there be opportunities for me to take...

dialogues.speaker: Cadmael
dialogues.text: Well, I failed my flight test. It went horribly. I couldn't fly well at all — in fact, I didn't even make it up to the clouds.

dialogues.speaker: Cadmael
dialogues.text: That makes it the second time now... To be honest, this is all pretty discouraging.

dialogues.speaker: Cadmael
dialogues.text: I know "second time" isn't a lot for many riders — but it's not a good sign all the same.

dialogues.speaker: Cadmael
dialogues.text: When I think about my tribespeople who've wasted the best half of their lives without success, throwing themselves into flying for years on end... I'm kinda scared that I'll become like them.

dialogues.speaker: Cadmael
dialogues.text: Perhaps... I have to just accept the fact that I'm "Wingless" and get out of here...

dialogues.speaker: Cadmael
dialogues.text: I just hope I'll make the right decision... And I hope you do, too.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But you haven't left yet, have you?

dialogues.speaker: Cadmael
dialogues.text: Yeah. I mean, I haven't completely lost all faith just yet.

dialogues.speaker: Cadmael
dialogues.text: I wouldn't be pacing here like this otherwise, would I?

dialogues.speaker: Cadmael
dialogues.text: Am I really cut out to be a rider? Do I really have the talent? Is one mistake going to ruin everything for me?

dialogues.speaker: Cadmael
dialogues.text: I know this idea may seem childish and like a waste of time to our elders, but people have to take responsibility for their own lives.

dialogues.speaker: Cadmael
dialogues.text: Haha, thanks for listening to my rambling. Hope I didn't waste your time.

dialogues.speaker: Cadmael
dialogues.text: I may be leaving soon, but the Flower-Feather Clan is a great place to be. I hope you enjoy your time here.
